title: Regulation of chromatin microphase separation by binding of protein complexes.
authors: Adame-Arana, Omar; Bajpai, Gaurav; Lorber, Dana; Volk, Talila; Safran, Samuel
one_liner_zh: 该文通过物理模型和模拟研究蛋白复合物（含转录因子）结合调控染色质微相分离，虽非直接TF-DNA结合位点预测，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作与结合调控的物理机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: We show evidence of the association of RNA polymerase II (RNAP) with chromatin in a core-shell organization, reminiscent of microphase separation where the cores comprise dense chromatin and the shell, RNAP and chromatin with low density. These observations motivate our physical model for the regulation of core-shell chromatin organization. Here, we model chromatin as a multiblock copolymer, comprising active and inactive regions (blocks) that are both in poor solvent and tend to be condensed in the absence of binding proteins. However, we show that the solvent quality for the active regions of chromatin can be regulated by the binding of protein complexes (e.g., RNAP and transcription factors). Using the theory of polymer brushes, we find that such binding leads to swelling of the active chromatin regions which in turn modifies the spatial organization of the inactive regions. In addition, we use simulations to study spherical chromatin micelles, whose cores comprise inactive regions and shells comprise active regions and bound protein complexes. In spherical micelles the swelling increases the number of inactive cores and controls their size. Thus, genetic modifications affecting the binding strength of chromatin-binding protein complexes may modulate the solvent quality experienced by chromatin and regulate the physical organization of the genome.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了RNA聚合酶II（RNAP）与染色质以核-壳结构结合的关联证据，这类似于微相分离，其中核心由致密染色质组成，壳层则由RNAP和低密度染色质构成。这些观察结果促使我们提出了调控核-壳染色质组织的物理模型。在此，我们将染色质建模为多嵌段共聚物，包含活性区和非活性区（嵌段），两者在无结合蛋白的情况下均处于不良溶剂中并倾向于凝聚。然而，我们表明，活性染色质区域的溶剂质量可通过蛋白质复合物（如RNAP和转录因子）的结合来调节。利用聚合物刷理论，我们发现这种结合导致活性染色质区域膨胀，进而改变非活性区域的空间组织。此外，我们使用模拟研究了球形染色质胶束，其核心由非活性区域组成，壳层由活性区域和结合的蛋白质复合物构成。在球形胶束中，膨胀增加了非活性核心的数量并控制其大小。因此，影响染色质结合蛋白复合物结合强度的遗传修饰可能调节染色质所经历的溶剂质量，并调控基因组的物理组织。
